import unittest

from solution import Assistant, CommandModule, Connection, RepeatModule


class ProbeModule(CommandModule):
    def __init__(self, connection, assistant):
        super().__init__(connection, assistant)
        self.calls = []

    def command_probe(self, sender, argument):
        self.calls.append((sender, argument))


class CommandModuleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_connection_preserves_exact_string_objects(self):
        connection = Connection()
        target = "".join(["tar", "get"])
        text = "".join(["some", " text"])
        connection.send(target, text)
        self.assertEqual(connection.sent, [(target, text)])
        self.assertIs(connection.sent[0][0], target)
        self.assertIs(connection.sent[0][1], text)

    def test_assistant_validation_and_identity_storage(self):
        for nickname in (None, 1, ""):
            with self.subTest(nickname=nickname), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                Assistant(nickname)
        nickname = "".join(["for", "ge"])
        assistant = Assistant(nickname)
        connection = Connection()
        module = CommandModule(connection, assistant)
        self.assertIs(assistant.nickname, nickname)
        self.assertIs(module.connection, connection)
        self.assertIs(module.assistant, assistant)

    def test_dispatch_plain_unknown_and_empty_messages(self):
        connection = Connection()
        module = ProbeModule(connection, Assistant("bot"))
        for message in ("", "   \t\n", "hello !probe", "!unknown stuff", "! argument"):
            with self.subTest(message=message):
                self.assertFalse(module.dispatch("sender", message))
        self.assertEqual(module.calls, [])
        self.assertEqual(connection.sent, [])

    def test_dispatch_case_normalization_and_trimmed_remainder(self):
        module = ProbeModule(Connection(), Assistant("bot"))
        sender = "".join(["send", "er"])
        message = "  !PrObE\t  alpha beta  \n"
        self.assertTrue(module.dispatch(sender, message))
        self.assertEqual(module.calls, [(sender, "alpha beta")])
        self.assertIs(module.calls[0][0], sender)
        self.assertTrue(module.dispatch(sender, "!PROBE"))
        self.assertEqual(module.calls[-1], (sender, ""))

    def test_first_token_is_the_entire_command_name(self):
        module = ProbeModule(Connection(), Assistant("bot"))
        self.assertFalse(module.dispatch("s", "!probe.extra value"))
        self.assertEqual(module.calls, [])

    def test_repeat_with_argument(self):
        connection = Connection()
        module = RepeatModule(connection, Assistant("Echo"))
        sender = "".join(["u", "ser"])
        argument = "".join(["hello", " world"])
        message = "!repeat   " + argument + "   "
        self.assertTrue(module.dispatch(sender, message))
        self.assertEqual(connection.sent, [(sender, argument)])
        self.assertIs(connection.sent[0][0], sender)
        self.assertEqual(connection.sent[0][1], "hello world")

    def test_repeat_without_argument(self):
        connection = Connection()
        assistant = Assistant("Helper")
        module = RepeatModule(connection, assistant)
        self.assertTrue(module.dispatch("Alice", " \t!REPEAT\n "))
        self.assertEqual(connection.sent, [("Alice", "Repeat from Alice via Helper")])

    def test_dispatch_requires_string_arguments_and_has_no_side_effect(self):
        connection = Connection()
        module = RepeatModule(connection, Assistant("bot"))
        for sender, message in ((1, "!repeat x"), ("s", None), (None, 4)):
            with self.subTest(sender=sender, message=message), self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                module.dispatch(sender, message)
        self.assertEqual(connection.sent, [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

- A credential is valid when `now` is nonnegative, `now >= IssuedAt`, and `now < ExpiresAt`; it is expired at the exact expiration second.
- Do not retain or mutate the secret slice.

import copy
import unittest

from solution import update_registry


class UpdateRegistryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_inputs(self):
        result = update_registry([], [])
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        self.assertIsNot(result, update_registry([], []))

    def test_ordered_operations_and_copy_isolation(self):
        records = [
            {"id": "a", "label": "Alpha", "level": 0, "cohort": "red"},
            {"id": "b", "label": "Beta", "level": 2, "cohort": "blue"},
        ]
        operations = [
            {"action": "change", "id": "a", "label": "A2", "level": 10**100},
            {"action": "add", "record": {"id": "c", "label": "Gamma", "level": 1, "cohort": "green"}},
            {"action": "remove", "id": "b"},
            {"action": "change", "id": "c", "cohort": "gold"},
        ]
        records_before = copy.deepcopy(records)
        operations_before = copy.deepcopy(operations)
        result = update_registry(records, operations)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"id": "a", "label": "A2", "level": 10**100, "cohort": "red"},
            {"id": "c", "label": "Gamma", "level": 1, "cohort": "gold"},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(records, records_before)
        self.assertEqual(operations, operations_before)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], records[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1], operations[1]["record"])
        result[0]["label"] = "mutated"
        self.assertEqual(records, records_before)
        self.assertEqual(operations, operations_before)

    def test_remove_then_readd_same_id_is_valid(self):
        records = [{"id": "x", "label": "Old", "level": 0, "cohort": ""}]
        operations = [
            {"action": "remove", "id": "x"},
            {"action": "add", "record": {"id": "x", "label": "New", "level": 3, "cohort": "c"}},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(update_registry(records, operations), [
            {"id": "x", "label": "New", "level": 3, "cohort": "c"}
        ])

    def test_blank_cohort_is_allowed_but_blank_id_and_label_are_not(self):
        valid = [{"id": "x", "label": "L", "level": 0, "cohort": ""}]
        self.assertEqual(update_registry(valid, []), valid)
        for field in ("id", "label"):
            record = {"id": "x", "label": "L", "level": 0, "cohort": "c"}
            record[field] = ""
            with self.subTest(field=field), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                update_registry([record], [])

    def test_malformed_top_level_and_records(self):
        bad_records = [
            {"id": "x", "label": "L", "level": 0},
            {"id": "x", "label": "L", "level": 0, "cohort": "c", "extra": 1},
            {"id": 1, "label": "L", "level": 0, "cohort": "c"},
            {"id": "x", "label": 1, "level": 0, "cohort": "c"},
            {"id": "x", "label": "L", "level": True, "cohort": "c"},
            {"id": "x", "label": "L", "level": -1, "cohort": "c"},
            {"id": "x", "label": "L", "level": 0, "cohort": 1},
            "record",
        ]
        for value in bad_records:
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                update_registry([value], [])
        for records, operations in (((), []), ([], ()), (None, []), ([], None)):
            with self.subTest(records=records, operations=operations), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                update_registry(records, operations)

    def test_duplicate_initial_and_operation_ids(self):
        duplicate = [
            {"id": "x", "label": "A", "level": 0, "cohort": "c"},
            {"id": "x", "label": "B", "level": 1, "cohort": "d"},
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            update_registry(duplicate, [])
        base = [{"id": "x", "label": "A", "level": 0, "cohort": "c"}]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            update_registry(base, [{"action": "add", "record": {"id": "x", "label": "B", "level": 1, "cohort": "d"}}])

    def test_malformed_operations(self):
        base = [{"id": "x", "label": "A", "level": 0, "cohort": "c"}]
        malformed = [
            "operation",
            {},
            {"action": "unknown"},
            {"action": "remove", "id": "x", "extra": 1},
            {"action": "remove"},
            {"action": "add"},
            {"action": "add", "record": base[0], "extra": 1},
            {"action": "change", "id": "x"},
            {"action": "change", "id": "x", "label": "A", "extra": 1},
            {"action": "change", "id": "x", "label": ""},
            {"action": "change", "id": "x", "level": True},
            {"action": "change", "id": "x", "cohort": 4},
            {"action": "remove", "id": 4},
        ]
        for operation in malformed:
            with self.subTest(operation=operation), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                update_registry(base, [operation])

    def test_unhashable_change_and_remove_ids_fail_atomically(self):
        records = [{"id": "x", "label": "Original", "level": 0, "cohort": "c"}]
        for action in ("change", "remove"):
            for bad_id in (["x"], {"value": "x"}):
                operation = {"action": action, "id": bad_id}
                if action == "change":

                operations = [
                    {"action": "change", "id": "x", "cohort": "updated"},
                    operation,

                before_records = copy.deepcopy(records)
                before_operations = copy.deepcopy(operations)
                with self.subTest(action=action, bad_id=bad_id), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    update_registry(records, operations)

                self.assertEqual(operations, before_operations)

        records = [{"id": "x", "label": "Original", "level": 0, "cohort": "c"}]
        operations = [
            {"action": "change", "id": "x", "label": "Changed"},
            {"action": "remove", "id": "missing"},

        self.assertEqual(records, before_records)
        self.assertEqual(operations, before_operations)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            update_registry(records, [{"action": "change", "id": "missing", "label": "X"}])

import unittest

from solution import RelationBuckets


class RelationBucketsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_initial_state_absent_get_and_reset(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        self.assertIs(buckets.dirty, False)
        snapshot = buckets.get("missing")
        self.assertEqual(snapshot, frozenset())
        self.assertIsInstance(snapshot, frozenset)
        self.assertIs(buckets.dirty, False)
        buckets.reset_dirty()
        self.assertIs(buckets.dirty, False)
        self.assertEqual(str(buckets), "")

    def test_key_normalization_across_scalar_list_and_set(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        self.assertTrue(buckets.add("x", "one"))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(["x"]), frozenset({"one"}))
        self.assertTrue(buckets.add(["a", "b"], [1, 2]))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(["a", "b"]), frozenset({1, 2}))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(("a", "b")), frozenset())
        self.assertTrue(buckets.add(("a", "b"), "tuple-scalar"))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(("a", "b")), frozenset({"tuple-scalar"}))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(["a", "b"]), frozenset({1, 2}))
        self.assertTrue(buckets.add({"z", "a"}, "set-key"))
        normalized_set_key = list(sorted({"z", "a"}, key=repr))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(normalized_set_key), frozenset({"set-key"}))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(["b", "a"]), frozenset())

    def test_add_noops_empty_values_and_add_empty(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        self.assertFalse(buckets.add("k", []))
        self.assertTrue(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("k"), frozenset())
        buckets.reset_dirty()
        self.assertFalse(buckets.add_empty("k"))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertFalse(buckets.add("k", set()))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertTrue(buckets.add("k", [1, 1, 2]))
        buckets.reset_dirty()
        self.assertFalse(buckets.add("k", {1, 2}))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)

    def test_add_empty_creates_bucket(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        self.assertTrue(buckets.add_empty("empty"))
        self.assertTrue(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("empty"), frozenset())
        buckets.reset_dirty()
        self.assertFalse(buckets.add_empty(["empty"]))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)

    def test_remove_membership_and_bucket_persistence(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        buckets.add("k", [1, 2, 3])
        buckets.reset_dirty()
        self.assertTrue(buckets.remove("k", [2, 9]))
        self.assertTrue(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("k"), frozenset({1, 3}))
        buckets.reset_dirty()
        self.assertFalse(buckets.remove("k", [2, 9]))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.remove("absent", [1]))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.remove("k", []))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertTrue(buckets.remove("k", {1, 3}))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("k"), frozenset())
        buckets.reset_dirty()
        self.assertFalse(buckets.add_empty("k"))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)

    def test_get_is_immutable_snapshot(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        buckets.add("k", [1, 2])
        snapshot = buckets.get("k")
        self.assertIsInstance(snapshot, frozenset)
        with self.assertRaises(AttributeError):
            snapshot.add(3)
        buckets.add("k", 3)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot, frozenset({1, 2}))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("k"), frozenset({1, 2, 3}))

    def test_unhashable_elements_fail_atomically(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        buckets.add("existing", "kept")
        buckets.reset_dirty()
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            buckets.add(["valid", []], [1])
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            buckets.add("new", [1, []])
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("new"), frozenset())
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            buckets.add("existing", ["new", {}])
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("existing"), frozenset({"kept"}))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            buckets.remove("existing", ["kept", []])
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("existing"), frozenset({"kept"}))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            buckets.add_empty([{}])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            buckets.get([[]])

    def test_string_representation_is_deterministically_sorted(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        buckets.add("z", [10, "a"])
        buckets.add(["a", 2], set())
        buckets.add(3, ["b", 1])
        expected_lines = []
        data = {
            ("z",): {10, "a"},
            ("a", 2): set(),
            (3,): {"b", 1},
        }
        for key in sorted(data, key=repr):
            expected_lines.append(f"{key!r}: " + ", ".join(repr(v) for v in sorted(data[key], key=repr)))
        self.assertEqual(str(buckets), "\n".join(expected_lines))

    def test_large_hashable_values(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        huge = 10**1000
        self.assertTrue(buckets.add(huge, huge))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(huge), frozenset({huge}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from collections import UserDict
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError

from solution import Route, compile_routes


def handler_a():
    return "a"


def handler_b():
    return "b"


def handler_c():
    return "c"


class CompileRoutesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_inputs_and_fresh_lists(self):
        first = compile_routes([])
        second = compile_routes([], {})
        self.assertEqual(first, [])
        self.assertEqual(second, [])
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)

    def test_route_is_immutable_dataclass(self):
        route = Route("/a", handler_a, "a")
        self.assertEqual((route.path, route.handler, route.name), ("/a", handler_a, "a"))
        with self.assertRaises((FrozenInstanceError, AttributeError)):
            route.path = "/changed"

    def test_preserves_specs_and_appends_sorted_assets(self):
        specs = [("/z", handler_a, "ordinary-z"), ("/m", handler_b, "ordinary-m")]
        assets = UserDict({"/static/z": handler_c, "/static/a": handler_a})
        specs_before = list(specs)
        assets_before = dict(assets)
        result = compile_routes(specs, assets)
        self.assertEqual([(r.path, r.name) for r in result], [
            ("/z", "ordinary-z"),
            ("/m", "ordinary-m"),
            ("/static/a", "asset:/static/a"),
            ("/static/z", "asset:/static/z"),
        ])
        self.assertIs(result[0].handler, handler_a)
        self.assertIs(result[1].handler, handler_b)
        self.assertIs(result[2].handler, handler_a)
        self.assertIs(result[3].handler, handler_c)
        self.assertEqual(specs, specs_before)
        self.assertEqual(dict(assets), assets_before)

    def test_new_route_objects_and_list_on_each_call(self):
        specs = [("/a", handler_a, "a")]
        first = compile_routes(specs)
        second = compile_routes(specs)
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first[0], second[0])
        self.assertIs(first[0].handler, handler_a)
        self.assertIs(second[0].handler, handler_a)

    def test_duplicate_paths_and_names(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes([("/a", handler_a, "a"), ("/a", handler_b, "b")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes([("/a", handler_a, "same"), ("/b", handler_b, "same")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes([("/asset", handler_a, "route")], {"/asset": handler_b})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes([("/ordinary", handler_a, "asset:/asset")], {"/asset": handler_b})

    def test_malformed_specs(self):
        malformed_items = [
            ["/a", handler_a, "a"],
            ("/a", handler_a),
            ("/a", handler_a, "a", "extra"),
            ("", handler_a, "a"),
            (1, handler_a, "a"),
            ("/a", "not callable", "a"),
            ("/a", handler_a, ""),
            ("/a", handler_a, 1),
        ]
        for item in malformed_items:
            with self.subTest(item=item), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                compile_routes([item])

    def test_malformed_assets(self):
        malformed = [
            [],
            {"": handler_a},
            {1: handler_a},
            {"/a": "not callable"},
        ]
        for assets in malformed:
            with self.subTest(assets=assets), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                compile_routes([], assets)

    def test_mixed_asset_key_types_raise_value_error_in_both_orders(self):
        assets_string_first = {"/valid": handler_a, 1: handler_b}
        assets_integer_first = {1: handler_b, "/valid": handler_a}
        for assets in (assets_string_first, assets_integer_first):
            before = dict(assets)
            with self.subTest(assets=assets), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                compile_routes([], assets)
            self.assertEqual(assets, before)

    def test_validation_does_not_call_handlers_or_mutate_inputs(self):
        calls = []

        def sensitive(*args, **kwargs):
            calls.append((args, kwargs))
            raise RuntimeError("must not be invoked")

        specs = [("/ok", sensitive, "ok"), ("", handler_a, "bad")]
        original = list(specs)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes(specs)
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])
        self.assertEqual(specs, original)
        result = compile_routes([("/ok", sensitive, "ok")])
        self.assertIs(result[0].handler, sensitive)
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import copy
import unittest

from solution import update_library


class UpdateLibraryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_inputs(self):
        self.assertEqual(update_library({}, {}, []), {"categories": {}, "books": {}})

    def test_all_operations_ordering_and_copy_isolation(self):
        categories = {9: "Nine", 2: "Two"}
        books = {
            8: {"title": "Eight", "category_id": 9},
            1: {"title": "One", "category_id": 2},
        }
        operations = [
            {"op": "add_category", "id": 5, "name": "Five"},
            {"op": "rename_category", "id": 2, "name": "Second"},
            {"op": "add_book", "id": 4, "title": "Four", "category_id": 5},
            {"op": "move_book", "id": 8, "category_id": 5},
            {"op": "delete_book", "id": 1},
            {"op": "delete_category", "id": 2},
        ]
        before_categories = copy.deepcopy(categories)
        before_books = copy.deepcopy(books)
        before_operations = copy.deepcopy(operations)
        result = update_library(categories, books, operations)
        self.assertEqual(list(result["categories"]), [5, 9])
        self.assertEqual(list(result["books"]), [4, 8])
        self.assertEqual(result, {
            "categories": {5: "Five", 9: "Nine"},
            "books": {
                4: {"title": "Four", "category_id": 5},
                8: {"title": "Eight", "category_id": 5},
            },
        })
        self.assertEqual(categories, before_categories)
        self.assertEqual(books, before_books)
        self.assertEqual(operations, before_operations)
        self.assertIsNot(result["categories"], categories)
        self.assertIsNot(result["books"], books)
        self.assertIsNot(result["books"][8], books[8])
        result["books"][8]["title"] = "Changed"
        self.assertEqual(books, before_books)

    def test_huge_positive_ids_are_valid_and_sorted(self):
        huge = 10**100
        result = update_library(
            {huge: "Huge", 1: "One"},
            {huge: {"title": "Book", "category_id": huge}},
            [],
        )
        self.assertEqual(list(result["categories"]), [1, huge])
        self.assertEqual(list(result["books"]), [huge])

    def test_delete_category_dependency_tracks_prior_operations(self):
        categories = {1: "A", 2: "B"}
        books = {10: {"title": "T", "category_id": 1}}
        result = update_library(categories, books, [
            {"op": "move_book", "id": 10, "category_id": 2},
            {"op": "delete_category", "id": 1},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(result["categories"], {2: "B"})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            update_library(categories, books, [{"op": "delete_category", "id": 1}])

    def test_initial_structure_validation(self):
        invalid_cases = [
            ([], {}, []),
            ({}, [], []),
            ({}, {}, ()),
            ({True: "Bool"}, {}, []),
            ({0: "Zero"}, {}, []),
            ({-1: "Negative"}, {}, []),
            ({1: ""}, {}, []),
            ({1: 2}, {}, []),
            ({1: "A"}, {True: {"title": "T", "category_id": 1}}, []),
            ({1: "A"}, {0: {"title": "T", "category_id": 1}}, []),
            ({1: "A"}, {2: {"title": "T"}}, []),
            ({1: "A"}, {2: {"title": "T", "category_id": 1, "extra": 3}}, []),
            ({1: "A"}, {2: {"title": "", "category_id": 1}}, []),
            ({1: "A"}, {2: {"title": "T", "category_id": True}}, []),
            ({1: "A"}, {2: {"title": "T", "category_id": 9}}, []),
        ]
        for categories, books, operations in invalid_cases:
            with self.subTest(categories=categories, books=books, operations=operations), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                update_library(categories, books, operations)

    def test_operation_exact_fields_and_value_validation(self):
        malformed = [
            "operation",
            {},
            {"op": "unknown"},
            {"op": []},
            {"op": {}},
            {"op": "add_category", "id": 2, "name": "B", "extra": 1},
            {"op": "add_category", "id": True, "name": "B"},
            {"op": "add_category", "id": 0, "name": "B"},
            {"op": "add_category", "id": 2, "name": ""},
            {"op": "add_book", "id": 2, "title": "T"},
            {"op": "add_book", "id": 2, "title": "", "category_id": 1},
            {"op": "add_book", "id": 2, "title": "T", "category_id": True},
            {"op": "rename_category", "id": 1, "name": "", "extra": 1},
            {"op": "move_book", "id": 1},
            {"op": "delete_book", "id": 1, "extra": 2},
            {"op": "delete_category", "id": False},
        ]
        for operation in malformed:
            with self.subTest(operation=operation), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                update_library({1: "A"}, {}, [operation])

    def test_shared_input_book_objects_are_updated_independently(self):
        categories = {1: "A", 2: "B"}
        shared_book = {"title": "Shared", "category_id": 1}
        books = {10: shared_book, 20: shared_book}
        before_categories = copy.deepcopy(categories)
        before_books = copy.deepcopy(books)
        result = update_library(categories, books, [
            {"op": "move_book", "id": 10, "category_id": 2}
        ])
        self.assertEqual(result["books"][10], {"title": "Shared", "category_id": 2})
        self.assertEqual(result["books"][20], {"title": "Shared", "category_id": 1})
        self.assertIsNot(result["books"][10], result["books"][20])
        self.assertEqual(categories, before_categories)
        self.assertEqual(books, before_books)
        self.assertEqual(shared_book, {"title": "Shared", "category_id": 1})

    def test_duplicates_and_missing_references(self):
        categories = {1: "A"}
        books = {2: {"title": "T", "category_id": 1}}
        operations = [
            {"op": "add_category", "id": 1, "name": "Again"},
            {"op": "add_book", "id": 2, "title": "Again", "category_id": 1},
            {"op": "add_book", "id": 3, "title": "X", "category_id": 9},
            {"op": "rename_category", "id": 9, "name": "X"},
            {"op": "move_book", "id": 9, "category_id": 1},
            {"op": "move_book", "id": 2, "category_id": 9},
            {"op": "delete_book", "id": 9},
            {"op": "delete_category", "id": 9},
        ]
        for operation in operations:
            with self.subTest(operation=operation), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                update_library(categories, books, [operation])

    def test_failure_after_valid_operations_is_atomic(self):
        categories = {1: "Original"}
        books = {2: {"title": "Book", "category_id": 1}}
        operations = [
            {"op": "rename_category", "id": 1, "name": "Changed"},
            {"op": "delete_category", "id": 1},
        ]
        before_categories = copy.deepcopy(categories)
        before_books = copy.deepcopy(books)
        before_operations = copy.deepcopy(operations)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            update_library(categories, books, operations)
        self.assertEqual(categories, before_categories)
        self.assertEqual(books, before_books)
        self.assertEqual(operations, before_operations)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
